subject.title: fix: preserve Feishu post line breaks

question: Should this PR wait for redacted Feishu/Lark proof on this branch, or should maintainers designate a different canonical fix for the linked Feishu newline bug?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not a narrow code repair; it is proof sufficiency plus maintainer choice among several open candidate branches with different message-delivery tradeoffs.

options.title: Require proof on this branch
options.body: Ask the contributor to add redacted Feishu/Lark rendered-message proof for normal prose, code fences, raw tables, and near-limit fallback before merge.

options.title: Repair and adopt the proof-positive sibling
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99394 as the canonical fix only after its conflicts are resolved and maintainers accept its broader fanout behavior.

options.title: Accept bounded fallback now
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally accept that near-limit messages keep original single newlines, but that should be an explicit message-delivery tradeoff decision.

recommendation.title: Require proof on this branch
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to add redacted Feishu/Lark rendered-message proof for normal prose, code fences, raw tables, and near-limit fallback before merge.
